_comment: A small HELD-OUT RAG evaluation set. Each item is a realistic SOC question with the set of document chunk IDs that are genuinely relevant (the ground truth for retrieval@k). corpus_docs lists the doc-chunk IDs that exist in the knowledge base. A retrieval is correct for a question if at least one relevant_docs id appears in the system's top-k retrieved ids. Use this with the recorded retrieval fixtures (retrieval-good.json / retrieval-regressed.json), or point eval.py at your real Module-04 RAG's retrieved ids.
